entities.name: Manuel de Mariátegui, 1st Count of San Bernardo
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Don Manuel de Mariátegui y Vinyals, 1st Count of San Bernardo was a Spanish noble and politician who served as Mayor of Madrid between 1892 and 1894 and as Minister of State in 1903. He married María del Rosario Pérez de Barradas, 13th Marquise of Peñaflor and had five children.
